user_prompt:
What is the effect of behavioural support, compared with brief advice or no intervention,
on tobacco use cessation? Keep the three intervention-combination subgroups (behavioural
support alone; behavioural support + NRT; behavioural support + varenicline) as separate
subgroups within one pooled analysis, since each has its own matched control arm (brief
advice, or brief advice + NRT, or varenicline alone respectively).

Some trials tested more than one behavioural-support variant against a single shared
control group — extract each variant as its own row against a proportional share of that
same control group, rather than picking only one variant or discarding the other.
